items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: And I worked for Tatum and Tatum loved him, you know.

ctx.x: Funny though. Amazing that his constitution stood up to it as long as it did.

I guess it might be but he was a tremendous person. And, somehow there was a little definition between the two of us, something in the trumpet he liked that I was doing and it was easy to like him because he had the greatest sound. And I worked for Tatum and Tatum loved him, you know. But, for sound at the piano I think Fats had the greatest sound I've ever heard in my life on the piano.
Yes, it was a very strong sound. It was a very musical sound, too.
